assumptions: The Dockerfile base python:3.12-slim is the platform this lock is qualified for; no other platform is claimed.

context_sources.selection_reason: C10 pack/release/migration contract governing the release manifest.
Binds the python:3.12-slim base family the resolver image must match.
Unchanged application dependency intent that this lock must preserve.
Normative provenance and artifact-hash obligations for frozen dependencies.
Determines which assertions count as contract evidence for this task.

decisions: Resolver is the pinned interpreter pip 25.0.1 inside python@sha256:2f17fc044b579bab302c2e8054d3a686e2cb9a83de48e70534b94cd8ebbe06a9; no second resolver was added.
en_core_web_sm stays a direct-URL wheel in requirements.txt; the lock installs it by name from the recorded artifact hash.
pyzk==0.9 and svglib==1.5.1 have no upstream wheel, so they stay hash-bound sdists and are built offline with the pinned wheel==0.47.0 backend.
minimality_evidence: Added no runtime dependency to requirements.txt; the lock only restates the existing resolution.
Reused the pinned interpreter and its pip instead of introducing pip-tools or a second resolver.
workpacket.outcome: Generate a complete transitive hash lock and wheel manifest without changing application behavior; bind the direct spaCy model artifact and installer/bootstrap versions

risk.recovery: Discard generated candidate locks/wheelhouse; preserve unchanged input requirements and base image. No database or production effect occurs. If a tracked lock was published, revert only that bounded artifact commit and its build reference.
